Chocolate Brownie Lava Cake 🍫🌋 Ingredients: - For Chocolate Sponge - • 240g plain flour • 30g cocoa powder • 400g granulated sugar • 2tsp bicarbonate of soda • 1tsp baking powder • 240ml milk • 110g vegetable oil • 2 large eggs • 1tsp vanilla extract • 50g milk chocolate • 150ml hot water - For Chocolate Icing - • 250g unsalted butter • 500g icing sugar • 50g cocoa powder • 1tsp vanilla extract • 3tbsp milk - For Brownie Lava - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 70g unsalted butter • 40g cocoa powder • 40g plain flour (heat treated) • 80g double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 70g milk chocolate - For Brownie Bites - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 90g unsalted butter • 60g cocoa powder • 120g plain flour (heat treated) • 2-3tbsp double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 100g chocolate chips Instructions: - For Chocolate Sponge - 1) In a large bowl, combine your flour, cocoa powder, granulated sugar, bicarbonate of soda, and baking powder 2) In another bowl, whisk together your milk, vegetable oil, eggs, vanilla extract, and 50g melted milk chocolate 3) Fold in your dry ingredients from before and add in 150ml hot water or coffee 4) Line three 8” cake tins and pour in the batter evenly. Bake in the oven at 160°C fan for around 25 minutes - For Icing - 1) Whisk your butter until light and creamy 2) Add in your icing sugar and cocoa powder 3) Once incorporated, whisk in your vanilla and milk until fluffy  - For Brownie Lava - 1) Melt the butter with both sugars over a medium heat 2) Whisk in the cocoa powder and flour 3) Gradually add in the cream until molten and thick, then stir in the vanilla extract and salt 4) Let it cool to just above room temperature and then add in the milk chocolate to slowly melt in 5) Once the lava has reached room temperature, you can use it on your cake! - For Bronwie Bites - 1) Cream together the butter and both sugars until fluffy 2) Mix in the cocoa powder, flour, and salt until sandy 3) Add in the vanilla extract and double cream 4) Once it has become a dough, fold in your chocolate chips, then press it firmly into a lined 9x9” square tin, refrigerate for 30 minutes, then cut into small bite sized pieces  Watch the video to see how I build and decorate the cake! I find it’s easier to ice the sponges when they are frozen/cold. Enjoy! :) #chocolate #cake #brownie #baking #recipes

VOLCÁN CHOCOLATE 👇receta escrita👇 CLICK @laura.lopez.mon para más recetas fáciles 💥GUÁRDATE💥 esta receta de pastel de chocolate | lava cake, facilísimo de hacer con 5 ingredientes, sin robots ¡nunca falla! ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍 INGREDIENTES 4 unidades 200 g chocolate (mínimo 55% de cacao) 70 g mantequilla 4 huevos M 70 g azúcar 50 g harina trigo común (sin levaduras) Para pincelar los moldes : mantequilla y cacao puro en polvo ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍ELABORACIÓN 🔹️ Pon en un recipiente el chocolate y la mantequilla y fúndelo. Deja atemperar 5 minutos 🔹️ Mientras pon en un bol los huevos y el azúcar y bate con unas varillas hasta que espumen. Añade el chocolate y mezcla con una espátula hasta que se integre por completo 🔹️ Añade la harina tamizada y mezcla con la espátula hasta que esté perfectamente integrado 🔹️ Pincela los moldes con mantequilla a punto de pomada y espolvorea con cacao en polvo 🔹️ Llena los moldes con la masa hasta 1 cm del borde. Introduce en el congelador 30 minutos 🔹️ Saca del congelador e introduce en el horno precalentado a 220°C durante 12 minutos ⚠️ la temperatura interior de tu horno puede variar respecto a la mía (cada horno es un mundo) por lo que el tiempo de cocción puede variar entre 12 y 15 minutos. Deberás probar variando los minutos hasta conseguir el punto, pero nunca será menos de 12 ni más de 15 🔹️ Saca del horno y deja reposar 2 minutos. Separa la pared con el fijo de un cuchillo y desmolda 🔹️ Sirve inmediatamente ➖➖➖➖➖➖➖ Feliz día 🤗 #lauralopezmon #lavacake #micuitchocolat #volcandechocolate #coulant

🤎 CROCKTOBER: EPISODE 13 🤎  CHOCOLATE LAVA CAKE 🍫 INGREDIENTS For the cake: 🍰 1 box Super Moist Chocolate Fudge or Milk Chocolate Cake Mix  🥛 1¼ cups milk 🛢️ ½ cup vegetable oil 🥚 3 eggs For the chocolate lava topping: 🍮 1 box (4 oz) instant chocolate pudding mix 🥛 2 cups milk 🍫 1 bag (12 oz) milk chocolate chips DIRECTIONS 1️⃣ Spray your crockpot with nonstick cooking spray. 2️⃣ Prepare the chocolate cake mix according to the package directions, using the milk, oil, and eggs listed above. 3️⃣ Pour the cake batter into the crockpot. 4️⃣ Prepare the instant chocolate pudding according to the package directions using 2 cups of milk. 5️⃣ Pour the pudding over the cake batter. DO NOT STIR! 🙅🏻‍♀️ 6️⃣ Sprinkle the entire bag of chocolate chips evenly over the top. 7️⃣ Cover and cook on LOW until the cake is set around the edges and gooey in the center. Start checking around 2 hours, since crockpots vary. Avoid lifting the lid too often! Scoop it into a bowl while it’s warm and top with vanilla ice cream. The hot-and-cold combination? Vulcão de ninho com Nutella  Ingredientes massa: 4 ovos 1 xícara (chá 250 ml ) de açúcar  200 ml de óleo  1 xícara de leite em pó  1 xícara de água  2 e 1/2 xícaras de farinha de trigo  1 colher (sopa) de fermento químico em pó  Preparo: Coloque no liquidificador todos os ingredientes exceto o trigo e o fermento. Bata por aproximadamente 2 minutos. Acrescente o trigo e o fermento por último e bata rapidamente (no liquidificador mesmo) só para misturar. Passe para forma untada com margarina e eleve para assar em forno pré aquecido, a 180 graus até dourar levemente em cima. Faça o teste do palito para se certificar que está assado corretamente. O tempo de forno é aproximadamente 40 minutos. Desenforme o bolo morno.  Ingredientes cobertura: 1 leite condensado  1 creme de leite  3 colheres (sopa) de leite em pó  Preparo: Coloque todos os ingredientes na panela e leve ao fogo médio, mexendo sempre até ferver. Depois mexa por mais 1 minuto e desligue. Depois de frio é só jogar sobre o bolo e colocar Nutella a gosto.  #campograndems #bolodeninho #receitafácil

🍫🥜 VOLCÁN DE CHOCOLATE + MANTEQUILLA DE MANÍ = otro nivel 😮‍💨✨ Santiago en la cocina nos preparó esta bombita de chocolate con centro de mantequilla de maní de @americanclassic.cl, literalmente el mejor invento para este postre 🤝 lo servimos tibiecito con helado de vainilla, syrup y quedó peligrosamente rico 👀🍦 ✨ Ingredientes: * 4 huevos * 1/2 taza azúcar * 150 gr mantequilla * 150 gr chocolate semiamargo * 1/2 taza harina * 150 gr mantequilla de maní American Classic 👩🏻‍🍳 Preparación: 1. Mezclar huevos y azúcar. 2. Derretir mantequilla + chocolate en tandas de 30 segundos en microondas y unir con la mezcla anterior. 3. Agregar harina y mezclar bien. 4. Enmantequillar moldes individuales y espolvorear cacao. 5. Poner la mitad de la mezcla, agregar 1 cucharadita de mantequilla de maní American Classic al centro y cubrir con más mezcla. 6. Hornear 20-25 min a 180°C en horno precalentado. Servir caliente con helado de vainilla y syrup American Classic porque sí o sí se merecen ese final 😍🍨

Le secret du Gâteau Volcan : Moelleux et irrésistible ! 🌋🍫. 1.La base : Battre les œufs avec le sucre et la vanille jusqu’à ce que le mélange blanchisse. 2.Les liquides : Ajouter l’huile tout en continuant de battre, puis verser le lait. 3.Le secret de la texture : Incorporer la farine (environ 300g) petit à petit. Attention : la quantité peut varier selon la qualité de votre farine (certaines absorbent plus que d’autres !). 4.La touche finale : Ajouter le cacao et la levure chimique en même temps que la farine. 5.	Le montage : Verser la pâte dans un moule de 27 cm de diamètre, puis déposer délicatement au centre la crème pâtissière maison. 6.	La cuisson : Enfourner à 180°C pendant 40 minutes. Allumer uniquement le bas au début, puis le haut en fin de cuisson pour dorer. 7.	La déco : Une touche de zeste de citron et du chocolat râpé pour le contraste des saveurs. 🍋🍫 Bon appétit ! ❤️ #GâteauVolcan #CakeChocolat #PatisserieMaison #RecetteFacile

🍫 GÂTEAU VOLCAN  Dimensions du moule ➡️Env. 22 × 18 cm  Ingrédients ➤ Gâteau 	•	3 œufs 	•	170 g d’huile neutre 	•	100g de sucre 	•	75 g de cacao non sucré 	•	240 g d’eau chaude 	•	180 g de farine 	•	15 g de levure chimique 	•	1 c. café rase de bicarbonate ➤ Sirop chocolat 	•	480 g de lait 	•	120 g de cacao 	•	30 g de beurre ➤ Ganache 	•	200 g de chocolat (noir, lait ou mix) 	•	200 g de crème liquide Étapes : Préchauffe ton four à 180°C chaleur tournante. Dans un grand bol, fouette ensemble les œufs, le sucre, l’huile, le cacao et l’eau chaude jusqu’à obtenir une pâte lisse. Ajoute la farine, la levure et le bicarbonate et mélange juste assez pour que la pâte soit homogène. Verse dans un moule beurré ou huilé d’environ 22 × 18 cm et enfourne 25 minutes, en surveillant dès 20 minutes : le centre doit rester tremblotant. Pendant la cuisson, prépare le sirop chocolat en chauffant le lait, le sucre, le cacao et le beurre jusqu’aux premiers frémissements puis coupe le feu. Dès que le gâteau sort du four, verse tout le sirop dessus et laisse absorber 10 à 15 minutes. Fais chauffer la crème, verse-la sur le chocolat, laisse fondre puis mélange et nappe le dessus. Sers tiède, à la cuillère, texture volcan garantie 😍🍫

BRIGADEIRO VOLCANO CAKE 🥕🐇🍫 This is a classic Brigadeiro Carrot Cake I grew up eating: super soft, moist, and topped with warm brigadeiro  Recipe Cake 400g carrots, peeled and chopped 6 eggs 2½ cups sugar 1½ cups neutral oil 4 cups all-purpose flour (sifted) 2 tbsp baking powder 1 pinch salt Preheat oven to 340°F / 170°C and grease a 15-cup bundt pan well. Blend the carrots and oil for about 1 minute, add the eggs and sugar and blend 2-3 minutes until completely smooth. In a bowl, sift the flour, pour in the carrot mixture and mix gently just until combined. Add a pinch of salt and the baking powder last and mix lightly. Pour into the pan, tap it a couple times on the counter to release air bubbles, and bake 50-60 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean. Let cool 10-15 minutes before removing from the pan. Brigadeiro Topping 2 cans sweetened condensed milk 4 tbsp cocoa powder 1 tbsp butter 7 oz / 200 g heavy cream Cook the condensed milk, cocoa, and butter over medium-low heat, stirring constantly until slightly thickened. Turn off the heat and stir in the heavy cream to make it silky and pourable. TIP: mix the cocoa powder with a bit of heavy cream first before adding to the condensed milk mixture While it's still warm, pour it over the center of the cake and let it overtlow.

Chocolate Volcano Cake Ingredients: 200g dark chocolate (70%) 150g butter 150g sugar 3 eggs 100g flour 25g cocoa powder 8g vanilla sugar 2g salt 3-4g baking powder (optional, for a fluffier texture) Preparation: Melting Chocolate and Butter Break the chocolate into pieces, mix it with butter, and melt over a double boiler or in the microwave (in short 20-second intervals, stirring in between). Making the Batter In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs with sugar and vanilla sugar until light and fluffy. Pour in the melted chocolate and butter mixture, then stir well. Sift in the flour, cocoa powder, salt, and baking powder (if using). Mix gently. Baking Preheat the oven to 170°C. Pour the batter into a 20cm round cake tin lined with parchment paper. Bake for 20-25 minutes. The cake should remain slightly moist inside (check with a toothpick—it should come out slightly sticky). Cooling and Serving Let the cake cool completely in the tin. Optionally, dust with powdered sugar or serve with a scoop of ice cream and caramel. Enjoy! 🍫🎂 #cake #easyrecipe #cupcakes #foodlover #brownies #chocolate #dessert #foodtok #fyp #cookie
